aspect: Nigeria does not print its own booklets
description: Despite owning a minting and printing company, Nigeria does not produce passport booklets. A 2021 shortage was tied to government debts to a foreign technical partner that refused to supply; in 2024 booklets were scarce nationwide for over a month ahead of an approved price increase.
energy_note: The document proving you are Nigerian is printed abroad, on credit.

aspect: The price tripled, and the racket did not stop
description: The standard booklet fee rose from NGN 35,000 to NGN 100,000 in August 2025, defended as an anti-corruption measure. Immigration officers themselves said the higher cost would not end racketeering, citing processing fees charged through system loopholes and the practical need for middlemen outside Lagos and Abuja.
money_note: NGN 35,000 to NGN 100,000, official fee alone.
energy_note: Tripled the price, kept the bribe.

description: An applicant who applied in August 2025 was still seeing 'processing' on the portal in January 2026, while a neighbour who applied the same day received his passport within weeks after paying an officer.
money_note: The informal payment that moves the file.
energy_note: Same day, same office, five months apart.

aspect: The digital portal did not remove the officer
description: A 2022 investigation found the 2019 e-passport portal failed to stem bribe demands, with officials hoarding booklets and inventing fees for applicants who would not pay.
energy_note: Digitised, and still transacted in cash.

description: Nigerians abroad report extortion and delays at consulates, where the queue is longer, the alternatives are none, and an expired passport puts the holder's residence status at risk in the host country.
energy_note: Your visa depends on a consulate that is not answering.

aspect: A late passport cascades into everything else
description: A job offer with a start date, a course with an enrolment deadline, a visa appointment already booked, a residence permit expiring. The booklet is upstream of all of them.
energy_note: One missing booklet, four missed deadlines.
